turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and I'm using them on one thing. The zero on Owen's essay goes back to what it was, and I'd like to hear why it went in before anyone called me.
Okay. You asked for this meeting, so I'll start with the question I came in with. Who decided to enter the zero, and was anyone talking to Owen before that happened?
I'm waiting, Hale. Who decided, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
We're not here about the weather, Hale. Who entered the zero, and what did you have in front of you when you did?
I'm writing down that you haven't answered. The zero comes off, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done. Which is it, Hale?
